projectContext: Sprint 13 (testing) completed all 10 stories covering rate-limiting intelligence tests: retry queue deadlock prevention, rate limit window estimation, escalation timeline export, tier effectiveness correlation, auto-scaling budget, stale checkpoint restoration, recommendation engine, health status aggregation, circuit breaker pause scaling, and speed tracker signal detection. Sprint 14 targets deeper integration-level testing gaps identified during sprint 13: AudioFirstPipeline has zero escalation/cookie integration tests, RateLimitBudget lacks thread safety, CookieMethodFallback has untested cross-keyword exhaustion paths, parallel downloads have only 10 config-level tests with no concurrency coverage, and checkpoint save/restore cycles for escalation timeline and tier outcomes are untested end-to-end.

userStories.title: Add AudioFirstPipeline escalation integration tests

All 12 tests pass.

userStories.title: Add CookieMethodFallback cross-keyword exhaustion tests

userStories.title: Add RateLimitBudget thread safety tests
userStories.notes: Created tests/test_budget_thread_safety.py with 14 tests across 5 classes: TestConcurrentRecordRotation (3 tests: 10 threads x1, 10 threads x100, keyword tracking), TestConcurrentCanRotateAndRecord (2 tests: budget limit enforcement under contention, tight single-rotation boundary), TestConcurrentRecordBackoff (3 tests: 5 threads different durations, 5 threads x100 small backoffs, keyword tracking), TestConcurrentSuccessFailure (3 tests: mixed success/failure from 10 threads, interleaved same-thread, failure keyword tracking), TestAtomicLastRotation (3 tests: 20-trial last-rotation atomicity, gated rotation count consistency, 50-thread stress test). All 14 tests pass. All 153 budget-related tests pass.
acceptanceCriteria: Test concurrent record_rotation() from 10 threads — verify rotations_used equals exactly 10 (no race condition overwrites)
Test concurrent can_rotate() + record_rotation() — verify budget never exceeds max_rotations even under contention
Test concurrent record_backoff_time() from 5 threads with different durations — verify backoff_time_spent is sum of all durations
Test concurrent record_success() + record_failure() — verify successes + failures equals total call count
Test can_rotate() returns False atomically when last rotation consumed — verify no two threads both get True when only 1 rotation remains

userStories.title: Add cookie rotator mid-session file validation tests
userStories.notes: Added mid-session file validation to CookieRotator (_is_cookie_file_valid, _remove_invalid_cookie, _find_valid_cookie methods) and integrated into get_current_cookie(), _select_round_robin(), _select_random(). Added TestMidSessionFileValidation class with 10 tests in tests/test_cookie_rotation.py: AC1 - rotate() with deleted cookie falls back gracefully; AC2 - rotate() with empty cookie skips to next; AC3 - rotate() with all deleted returns None + logs warning; AC4 - single cookie round-robin no infinite loop; AC5 - get_current_cookie() returns None/fallback after deletion; plus 5 additional coverage tests (all-deleted returns None, invalid tracking, chain skip, _is_cookie_file_valid unit test, status reflection). All 38 cookie_rotation tests pass (1 skipped on Windows), all 93 related cookie tests pass.
acceptanceCriteria: Test rotate() when current cookie file is deleted mid-session — verify graceful fallback to next available cookie (no FileNotFoundError crash)
Test rotate() when cookie file becomes empty (0 bytes) mid-session — verify it skips to next cookie instead of using empty file

Test round-robin rotation with single cookie file — verify it returns that file on every call (no infinite loop in _select_round_robin)
Test get_current_cookie_path() after cookie deletion — verify returns None rather than path to deleted file
